color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; font-weight: bold !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Visitor sends a message
to the chat assistant

div.style: color: rgb(15, 17, 17) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
More than 10 messages
in the last minute?

div.style: color: rgb(15, 17, 17) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p: Ask them to wait a moment

div.style: color: rgb(15, 17, 17) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Is the message OK?
not empty, not too long, and not
trying to change the assistant's rules

div.style: color: rgb(15, 17, 17) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Explain the message
couldn't be sent

div.style: color: rgb(15, 17, 17) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Add our instructions for the assistant
and send the conversation
to the AI service

div.style: color: rgb(15, 17, 17) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Did the AI
service answer?

div.style: color: rgb(15, 17, 17) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Say the assistant is busy,
please try again later

div.style: color: rgb(15, 17, 17) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Show the reply on screen
bit by bit as it arrives

div.style: color: rgb(15, 17, 17) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Did the whole reply
arrive within 2 minutes?

div.style: color: rgb(15, 17, 17) !important; font-weight: bold !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p: Reply complete

div.style: color: rgb(15, 17, 17) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Tell them the reply
was interrupted

div.style: color: rgb(15, 17, 17) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center; width: 340px;

span.p: The AI service's password (API key) stays on our server, so visitors can never see or misuse it.
